scenes.line1: Do your tests match real users?
scenes.say: Are your performance tests just numbers, or do they really reflect what users do? Let’s see why modeling real workloads matters.

scenes.label: Modeling
scenes.sub: Simulate user behavior, request patterns, and data volumes.
scenes.say: Workload modeling means simulating how real users behave, the types of requests they send, and how much data they generate.
Start by analyzing production logs. Mix request types, set realistic delays between actions, and add real-world concurrency.
If you use a fake workload, you’ll miss hidden issues. Only a realistic mix uncovers real bottlenecks.

scenes.question: What’s a common modeling mistake?
scenes.right: Ignoring think time and user pacing can make results useless.
scenes.say: Here’s a trap: Focusing only on request types. But if you skip user pacing and think time, your results won’t reflect reality.
